item.title: Forged In FreeCAD: 4Axis for CNC ring engraving
item.description: We’ve featured a few projects under the “Forged In FreeCAD” title but what caught our eye with this one is that FreeCAD was used to not only create an innovative solution, but also was used to then help operate the created machine.
